pattern: ^SELECT min\(\(.*\)\) FROM (.*) WHERE (.*) NOT IN \(( SELECT student\_id|friend\_id FROM Friend UNION ALL SELECT student\_id|friend\_id FROM Friend )\)$
correction: Join the Friend and Highschooler tables correctly to exclude students who have friends.

metadata.description: This rule identifies incorrect usage of the NOT IN operator with a UNION ALL in the WHERE clause, which leads to improper filtering of students.
